ca:
1ca
m. [ts], the sound ‘c’ ; the consonant ‘c’; Sadd 604,.19 (ca cha ja jha ña); 605,.31; 827,.19 (vyañjanantassa dhātussa co hoti chapaccaye pare: jigucchati); —    °-kāra1,    m., the letter or sound ‘c’; Sp 1400,.28 foll. (~o jakāraṃ āpajjati jakāro ~aṃ āpajjati); Ap-a 376,.14 (ārohapariṇāharūpavayānaṃ sundaratāya sakārassa ~aṃ katvā Cundo ti nāmaṃ kariṃsu); Sadd 635,.9 foll. (pakārassa ca ~-ttaṃ); 854,.25; — cakāraṃ in Ee at Pj II 205,.26 is wr for cākāraṃ (Be, Ce, Se so); —     °-vagga,    m., the palatal consonants; Sadd 608,.29 (ivaṇṇacavagga-yakārā tālujā); 826,.14 (abbhāse vattamāno kavaggo ~-ttaṃ āpajjati).

2ca
ind. [ts], 1. an enclitic conjunctive particle (connecting parts of sentences or whole sentences; when connecting two words, follows both or only the second; when connecting more than two words, follows each word, or some, or only the final word; the first ca is often strengthened with eva); (i) and, both, also; moreover, as well as; Abh 1187 (samuccaye samāhāre ’nvācaye cetarītare … ca casaddo); M I 92,.37 foll. (carato ca me tiṭṭhato ca suttassa ca jāgarassa ca); 93,.10 foll. (taṃ ca pan’ amhākaṃ ruccati c’ eva khamati ca tena c’ amhā attamānā ti); S I 189,.32 (āyasmā Sāriputto bhikkhū dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti … te ca bhikkhū … dhammaṃ suṇanti); III 65,.12 (evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sattaṭṭhānakusalo hoti. kathaṃ ca bhikkhave bhikkhu tividhūpaparikkhī hoti); Dhp 256 (yo ca atthaṃ anatthaṃ ca ubho niccheyya panḍito); 261 (yamhi saccaṃ ca dhammo ca ahiṃsā saṃyamo damo); Ud 3,.27 (āyasmā ca Sāriputto āyasmā ca Mahā-moggallāno …; Ud-a 57,.18 : casaddo samuccayattho); It 41,.6 (jāgaro c’ assa bhikkhave bhikkhu vihareyya sato sampajāno samāhito pamudito vippasanno ca; It-a I 172,.26 : casaddo sampiṇḍanattho, tena vakkhamāne satādibhāve sampiṇḍeti); Th 295 (yaṃ c’ amhi putto buddhassa yaṃ ca dhammesu cakkhumā; Th-a II 125,.18 : yan ti yasmā, casaddo samuccayattho); 600 (yaṃ ca aññe na rakkhanti yo ca aññe na rakkhati); Ja I 151,.23 (tuyhaṃ ca tassā ca abhayaṃ dammī ti); 167,.1 (tvaṃ mahāsaddena hasi c’ eva rodi ca); III 82,24* (subhaddako c’ eva supesalo ca); 127,.5 (macchamaṃsena c’ eva phalāphalena ca paṭijaggiṃsu); 190,6* foll. (sā maṃ annena pānena vatthena sayanena ca attanā pi ca …); V 184,22* foll. (koso ca tuyhaṃ vipulo koṭṭhāgāraṃ ca tuyhaṃ paripūraṃ paṭhavī ca tuyhaṃ vijitā); Mil 18,.21 (dibbāni candanacuṇṇāni c’ eva dibbāni ca mandāravapupphāni abhippavassiṃsu); Vism 59,.8 foll. (sīlaṃ c’ eva suparisuddhaṃ bhavissati vatāni ca sampajjissanti); Mhv 6:21 (aṭṭito puttasokena na ca khādi na cāpivi); 25:97 (iti vatvā mahārājā kataññū idam āha ca); Sadd 887,.18 foll. (ca iti anvācaye itaretarayoge samāhāre vyatireke … ca pavattati … anvācaye bhikkhaṃ ca dehi gavaṃ cānehī ti … itaretarayoge samaṇo ca tiṭṭhati brāhmaṇo ca tiṭṭhati … samāhāre sītaṃ ca uṇhaṃ ca sītuṇhaṃ …); 903,.21 foll. (ca vā icc ete padāvasāne ca dvinnaṃ samānādhikaraṇapadānaṃ majjhe ca nipatanti na padādimhi, taṃ yathā samaṇo ca brāhmaṇo ca … eso ca samaṇo sādhurūpo eso ca brāhmaṇo sādhurūpo); — (ii) (according to cts) including unexpressed objects similar to that or those expressed: etc; and so on; Sn 118 (gāmāni nigamāni ca; Pj II 178,.30 : ettha casaddena nagarānī ti pi vattabbaṃ); Th 647 (mettaṃ ca abhijānāmi appamāṇaṃ subhāvitaṃ; Th-a II 273,.25 : casaddena karuṇaṃ muditaṃ upekkhaṃ cā ti itarabrahmavihāre saṅgaṇhāti); 770 (passa cittakataṃ rūpaṃ maṇinā kuṇḍalena ca; Th-a III 35,.24 : casaddena sesābharaṇālaṅkāre saṅgaṇhāti); Bv 10:5 (pāpuṇī kevalaṃ bodhiṃ buddhañāṇe ca cuddasa; Bv-a 185,.10 foll. : casaddo sampiṇḍanattho, tena aparāni [ñāṇāni] … sakale ca buddhaguṇe pāpuṇī ti attho); Cp 1:4:4 (iti sāyaṃ ca pāto ca ghosāpemi; Cp-a 42,.19 : ettha casaddena majjhantike cā ti āharitvā vattabbaṃ); — (iii) expressing immediate connection between two actions or their simultaneous occurrence; Thī 479 (sā c’ evaṃ bhaṇati pitaraṃ Anīkaratto ca … upayāsi … vāreyyaṃ); 481 (sā ca tahiṃ samāpannā Anīkaratto ca āgato nagaraṃ); 482 (sā ca manasikaroti Anīkaratto ca āruhi turitaṃ); — (iv) in grammatical texts, connecting the statement with words in previous statements; Sadd 330,.17 (kakha hasane: kakhati. jakkha bhakkhane ca, hasanānukaḍḍhanatthaṃ cakāro: jakkhati); 566,.22 (daṃsa daṃsane: daṃseti … dasi dassane ca, cakāro daṃsanaṃ apekkhati); — 2. a disjunctive particle: but, on the other hand; yet; A I 58,.18 (yasmā ca kho bhikkhave sakkā akusalaṃ pajahituṃ); It 3,.30 (sabbaṃ bhikkhave anabhijānaṃ … sabbaṃ ca kho bhikkhave abhijānaṃ; It-a I 54,.12 : casaddo vyatireke); Sn 1003 (sace agāram ajjhāvasati … sace ca so pabbajati agārā anagāriyaṃ); Th 106 (ekaṅgadassī dummedho satadassī ca paṇḍito; Th-a I 227,.18 foll. : paṇḍito pana … sabbaso passati); 130 (yo ca kho annapānassa lābhī hoti ’dha puggalo; Th-a II 10,.20 foll. : casaddo vyatireke … ayaṃ h’ ettha attho, yo pana puggalo …); 276 (pare ca na vijānanti … vijānanti ca ye dhammaṃ …; Th-a II 115,.12 : ye pana satthu sāsanadhammaṃ yathābhūtaṃ jānanti); Thī 128 (yassa maggaṃ na jānāsi … maggaṃ ca kho ’ssa jānāsi); 144 (nakkhattāni namassantā … bālā … ahaṃ ca kho namassantī sambuddhaṃ …); Ja II 110,19* (ciraṃ pi kho taṃ khādeyya gadrabho haritaṃ yavaṃ pāruto sīhacammena, ravamāno ca dūsayi; 110,22´ : attana pana gadrabharavaṃ ravamāno …); 160,11* (mahatī vata te bondi na ca paññā tadūpikā); III 128,3* (adassanena morassa … kākaṃ … apūjesuṃ … yadā ca sarasampanno moro Bāverum āgamā …); Sadd 887,.18 foll. (ca iti … vyatireke … vyatireke yo ca buddhaṃ ca dhammaṃ cā ti gāthāyaṃ yo cā ti ettha casaddo vyatirekatthavācako so ca casaddo pubbe vuttatthāpekkhako … ettha yo cā ti yo panā ti attho); — 3. in the protasis of conditional sentences: if; also frequently in a second conditional clause; (note also ca = but, in a following sentence rejecting the condition); D I 186,.3 (oḷāriko ca hi te … attā abhavissa rūpī … aññā va saññā abhavissa añño attā); II 36,.9 (ahaṃ c’ eva kho pana dhammaṃ deseyyaṃ pare ca me na ājāneyyuṃ, so mam’ assa kilamatho); A I 58,.21 foll. (akusalaṃ ca h’ idaṃ bhikkhave pahīnaṃ … dukkhāya saṃvatteyya, nāhaṃ evaṃ vadeyyaṃ akusalaṃ bhikkhave pajahathā ti, yasmā ca kho bhikkhave akusalaṃ pahīnaṃ … sukhāya saṃvattati …); V 87,.22 foll. (ime ca … dasa dhammā loke na saṃvijjeyyuṃ … yasmā ca kho … ime dasa dhammā loke saṃvijjanti); Th 468 (buddho ca me varaṃ dajjā so ca labbhetha me varo; Th-a II 197,.27 foll. : sace buddho bhagavā … mayhaṃ … varaṃ dadeyya) ≠ Ja V 216,1*; Ja V 185,22* (idaṃ ca tuyhaṃ rucitaṃ); VI 208,1* foll. (etaṃ ca saccaṃ vacanaṃ bhaveyya … yasmā ca etaṃ vacanaṃ abhūtaṃ); — 4. an emphatic particle, emphasising the preceding word; an expletive particle; Abh 1187 (padapūraṇamatte ca casaddo avadhāraṇe); D I 207,.6 foll. (atha ca pana bhavaṃ Ānando evam āha atthi c’ ev’ ettha uttariṃ karaṇīyan ti); M I 91,.9 (evaṃ cāhaṃ bhante bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi); Th 675 (rajam ūhataṃ ca vātena yathā meghopasāmaye; Th-a III 4,.12 : ca iti nipātamattaṃ); Ja III 188,.13 (so … Bharukacchaṃ pāpuṇi. tadā ca Bharukacchavāṇijā nāvāya Suvaṇṇabhūmiṃ gacchanti); Sp 879,.19 foll. (sace ca mayaṃ jāneyyāmā ti sace mayaṃ jāneyyāma, cakāro pana nipātamattam eva); Mhv 25:109 (sagga-maggantarāyo ca natthi te tena kammunā); Sadd 887,.18 foll. (ca iti … avadhāraṇādisu ca pavattati); — na ca, and not, rather than; Ja I 153,.2 (ahaṃ rajjaṃ jaheyyaṃ na ca taṃ patiññaṃ); — 5. ca following an interrogative pronoun, makes it indefinite; — see sv ka3; — 6. ca following a relative pronoun probably makes it indefinite, while itself retaining a conjunctive sense; S II 65,.15 foll. (yaṃ ca kho bhikkhave ceteti yaṃ ca pakappeti yaṃ ca anuseti ārammaṇaṃ etaṃ hoti viññāṇassa ṭhitiyā … yato ca kho bhikkhave no c’ eva ceteti no ca pakappeti no ca anuseti …); Dhp 256 (yo ca atthaṃ anatthaṃ ca ubho niccheyya paṇḍito); Ja VI 211,2* (bhovādi bhovādina mārayeyyuṃ ye cāpi tesaṃ abhisaddaheyyuṃ); —    °-kāra2,    m., the word ‘ca’; Sp 879,.20 (~o pana nipātamattam eva); Ps IV 137,.16 (te cā ti ~o āgamasandhimattaṃ); As 297,.21 (~o sampiṇḍanattho); Ap-a 194,.9 (ādito vuttaṃ ~aṃ parato netvā); Sadd 566,.22; — cakāram in Ee at Pj II 205,.26 is wr for cākāram (Be, Ce, Se so).
dhona:
1dhona
mfn. [prob. pp of dhovati, or possibly of dhunāti; cf S. dhūna; Sadd 497,.7 : dhū kampane: dhunāti dhūmo dhonā dhono dhuto], purified, pure; M I 386,16* (~assa … bhagavato, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se monassa; Ps III 97,.23 : ~assā ti dhonaṃ vuccati ñāṇaṃ tena samannāgatassa dhutakilesassa vā, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se monassā ti monaṃ …); Sn 351 (pahīnajātimaraṇaṃ asesaṃ niggayha ~aṃ vadessāmi dhammaṃ; Pj II 349,.25 : ~an ti dhutasabbapāpaṃ) = Th 1271; Sn 786 (~assa hī n’ atthi kuhiñci loke pakappitā diṭṭhi bhavābhavesu; Nidd I 78,.27 : so dhutarāgo dhutapāpo dhutakileso dhutapariḷāho ti ~o; Pj II 522,.23 : yo panāyaṃ sabbadiṭṭhigatādidosadhunanāya paññāya samannāgata-ttā ~o tassa ~assa …); 834 (~ena yugaṃ samāgamā; Pj II 542,.23 : dhutakilesena buddhena saddhiṃ); — see also atidhonacāri(n), dhuta (sv dhunāti), dhota (sv dhovati).
pāvusa:

pāvussa m. (and mfn.?) 1. (m.) [S. prāvṛṣ, prāvṛṣa], the rainy season, the rains; Abh 80 (vasso vassānapāvusā); Th 598 (yathā abbhāni verambo vāto nudati ~e); 1153 (ārakā parivajjeyya gūthaṭṭhānaṃ va ~e); Ja V 5,31* (girikandarā … abhisandanti ~e, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee ~o; cf CPD sv abhisandati); 202,27* (cirīṭisaṅghā-r-iva ~amhi, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se tiriṭisaṅghā; 206,1´ : tāni piḷandhanāni ~e navavaṭṭhe deve cirīṭisaṅghā viya viravanti, Ce so; Ee ~e navavaṭṭe [so read]; Be ~amhi pavuṭṭhe deve; Se ~ena vuṭṭhe deve); — 2. (mfn.) of the rainy season; Th-a II 256,.19 (yathā ~e kāle, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee pāvusse kāle); —      °-kāla, m., the time of the rains, the rainy season; Th-a I 82,.7 (~e meghagajjitaṃ sutvā, Ee so; Be, Ce, Se pāvussa-); II 256,.3 (~e, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee pāvussa-).

2pāvusa
m. [?], a kind of fish; Abh 671; Ja IV 70,21* (pāṭhīnaṃ ~aṃ macchaṃ … bhuñjasi; 70,24´ : ~an ti mahāmukhamacchaṃ, pāgusan ti pi pāṭho, Ee so; Be, Ce pāhusan ti pi; Se rāhusan ti pi); VI 278,4* (pāṭhīnā ~ā macchā) ≠ Ap 15,.13 ≠ 362,.6; Sadd 500,.13.

abhisambhavati:
abhisambhavati
abhisambhoti abhisambhuṇāti pr. 3 sg. [S. abhisam√bhū; BHS abhisambhuṇati, abhisambhāvayati], reaches, attains; is able, capable (of); is adequate; masters; endures, bears; —     abhisambhavati :   Sn 960 (kati parissayā loke gacchato amataṃ disaṃ ye bhikkhu ~e pantamhi sayanāsane; Nidd I 471,.22 : ye parissaye ~eyya abhibhaveyya ajjhotthareyya); Ja V 150,7* (yathā gatiṃ te ~ema; 150,9´ : ~ema pāpuṇeyyāma); Paṭis II 193,.30 (tassa atthe ca dhamme ca niruttiyā ca paṭibhāṇe ca na añño koci sakkoti ~ituṃ); — part.pr. (a) neg. anabhisambhava(t), mfn., A I 234,.27 (taṃ … anabhisambhavaṃ appaṭivijjhaṃ); (b) abhisambhavanta, mf (~antī) n., Nidd I 491,.1 (~anto); Thī-a 221,.2 (~antī sādhentī ti attho); —      abhisambhoti :   D II 232,.19 (ye pi ’ssa pitā kammante ~osi te pi kammante ~oti); A IV 241,.19 (bhāvanāmayaṃ puññakiriyavatthuṃ nābhisambhoti); Ja III 140,24* (tāni ce nābhisambhoma hoti no kālapariyāyo; 140,26´ foll. : yadi tāni na pāpuṇāma); V 421,.8 (khippam eva ~onti ratatthāya); VI 507,31* (paṭibhayāni me sabbāni ~ossaṃ; 508,32´ : sahissāmi adhivāsessāmi); Pj II 491,.17 (taṃ kātuṃ vā ~otuṃ vā sukhaṃ bhaveyya); — part.pr. abhisambhonta, mf (~ontī) n., Th 351 (lūkhaṃ pi ~onto); Thī 329 (~ontī); Ja VI 292,30* (sabbāni ~onto; 293,6´ : sabbāni rājakiccāni karonto); —      abhisambhuṇāti,    abhisambhunāti :   Sp 2,9* (na kiñci atthaṃ ~āti); Ud-a 164,.31 (nānubhavanti na ~anti na sakkonti); Peṭ 33,.22 (satta satta niruttiyo nābhisambhuneyyā ti n’ etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati, niruttipaṭisambhidā); 171,.9 (yathā gambhīre udapāne udakaṃ cakkhunā passati na ca kāyena abhisambhunāti); Sadd 494,.5 (na ~ātī ti na sampāpuṇāti na sādhetī ti vuttaṃ hoti); — part.pr. (a) neg. anabhisambhuṇanta, mfn., Nidd I 76,.18; Vism 347,.17; (b) neg. anabhisambhuṇamāna, mfn., D I 101,.3 (imaṃ yeva anuttaraṃ vijjācaraṇasampadaṃ an-abhisambhuṇamāno); III 94,.17 (taṃ jhānaṃ an-abhisambhuṇamānā); — aor. 3 sg. (a) abhisambhosi, D II 232,.19 (ye pi ’ssa pitā kammante abhisambhosi); (b) abhisambhuni, Thī-a 212,.36 (na asakkhi na abhisambhunī ti); 1 sg. abhisambhosiṃ, Ap 129,.1 (āvāsaṃ abhisambhosiṃ patvāna assamaṃ ahaṃ); — absol. (a) abhisambhavitvā, Sn 52; (b) abhisambhutvā, Th 1057; (c) abhisambhuṇitvā, Sp 604,.11 (yo … araññe vāsaṃ abhisambhuṇitvā); —      pp     abhisambhūta,   mfn., attained; Nidd-a I 253,.30; — ifc see veyyāvaccâ-; — fpp (a) neg. anabhisambhavanīya, mfn. ind. [abhi + acc. of samparāya], in a future state; in the next existence; D III 83,.19 (diṭṭhe c’ eva dhamme ~aṃ ca; Sv 864,.2 foll. : idhattabhāve ca parattabhāve ca) quoted Mil 162,.20; M I 515,.31 (iminā bhotā satthārā samasamagatiko bhavissāmi ~aṃ); A I 48,.25 (kāyaduccaritassa kho pāpako vipāko ~aṃ); Vv 31:8 (kāyassa bhedā ~aṃ); Ja V 221,20* (pāpaṃ ca passa ~aṃ); Pp 38,.10 (ekacco satthā diṭṭheva dhamme attānaṃ saccato thetato paññāpeti ~aṃ ca) quoted Kv 68,.9.
aggaṅkura:
1agga
mfn. and n. [cf S., BHS agra, S. agrya], 1. (mfn.) the first, foremost; topmost; better; excellent, illustrious; the best, chief (very often iic); (n.) the best part; the ideal; a most excellent thing; the best of its class or type; Abh 696; 715 (~aṃ paṭhamaṃ); 843; Vin III 90,.20 (ayaṃ ~o mahācoro yo asantaṃ abhūtaṃ uttarimanussadhammaṃ ullapati); 133,.23 (etaṃ ~aṃ etaṃ seṭṭhaṃ etaṃ mokkhaṃ …); D I 124,.4 (sīlapaññānaṃ ca pana lokasmiṃ ~am akkhāyati); II 4,.20 (Vipassissa … sāvakayugaṃ ahosi ~aṃ bhaddayugaṃ); 15,.10 (dhammatā esā … sampatijāto bodhisatto … āsabhiṃ ca vācaṃ bhāsati ~o ’ham asmi lokassa jeṭṭho ’ham asmi lokassa); S II 29,.6 (na … hīnena ~assa patti hoti, ~ena ca … ~assa patti hoti); III 156,.6 (kūṭāgārassa yā kāci gopānasiyo … kūṭaṃ tāsaṃ ~am akkhāyati); IV 315,.4 (ekaṃ khettaṃ ~aṃ ekaṃ khettaṃ majjhimaṃ ekaṃ khettaṃ hīnaṃ); A I 15,.8 (appamattikā esā bhikkhave vuddhi yadidaṃ ñātivuddhi, etad ~aṃ vuddhīnaṃ yadidaṃ paññāvuddhi); III 51,8* (~assa dātā labhate pun’ ~aṃ); It 87,.19 foll. m. (and n.) [S., BHS dharma], dhamma denotes (an interpretation of) the essential nature and reality of existence and experience, the way things are: it is descriptive and prescriptive; it denotes also an essential attribute of men or animals; a quality or characteristic; Abh 784 (~o sabhāve pariyattipaññāñāyesu saccappakatīsu puññe ñeyye guṇācārasamādhisū pi nissattatāpattisu kāraṇādo); see also Sv 99,.3 foll., Ps I 17,.16 foll., It-a I 37,.20 foll., Paṭis-a 18,.1 foll., Bv-a 13,.4 foll., As 38,.23 foll. and Sadd 560,.25 foll.; — for Buddhists dhamma is used to denote an interlocking and interdependent assembly of concepts: the true nature of the world of experience, how that world works, and the way to transcend it, as understood by the Buddha; the progressive stages of understanding and nibbāna ; the behaviour, the practice, required to achieve understanding of the way the world of experience works, ie the way to reach arhatship, nibbāna ; the understanding and practice taught by the Buddha, the substance of his teaching, the texts of the Canon, especially the Suttapiṭaka ; all constituents of the world of experience, physical and mental, external and internal, progressively more and more minutely analysed; all constituents of prescribed practice, appropriate and beneficial actions; prescriptions for the members of the saṅgha ; — for people generally dhamma is an interpretation of the essential nature of existence and experience; the way one should act, depending on who one is, to maintain the way things are and should be; duty; right; justice; normative and beneficial actions; — 1. (i) how the world of experience works, the processes by which it works and is explained (especially as formulated in cattāri ariyasaccāni and paṭiccasamuppāda ), and the possibility and way of transcending it, as understood by the Buddha and taught by him (so that knowledge and understanding of it might bring enlightenment, arhatship, to others); Vin I 2,3* (yadā have pātubhavanti ~ā ātāpino jhāyato brāhmaṇassa ath’ assa kaṅkhā vapayanti sabbā yato pajānāti sahetudhammaṃ; Sp 954,.19 foll. : pātubhavantī ti uppajjanti ~ā ti anulomapaccayākārapaṭivedhasādhakā bodhipakkhiyadhammā, atha vā pātubhavantī ti pakāsenti abhisamayavasena vyattā pākaṭā honti, ~ā ti caturāriyasaccadhammā); 11,.2 (idaṃ dukkhaṃ ariyasaccan ti me bhikkhave pubbe ananussutesu ~esu cakkhuṃ udapādi); 12,.24 (ehi bhikkhū ti bhagavā avoca svākkhāto ~o cara brahmacariyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā ti); 15,.31 (idaṃ kho Yasa anupaddutaṃ idaṃ anupassaṭṭhaṃ ehi Yasa nisīda ~aṃ te desessāmī ti); 40,.19 foll.
